title: JudgeVerdict
description: Judge Agent -> Orchestrator (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2): scored outcome plus drift-check signal (§6's gold-set agreement-rate method).

evidence.description: Whatever the Judge extracted from the target's response supporting this outcome; free-form but always present (may be empty for a clean fail).

agreement_rate.description: Judge's agreement rate with the gold-labeled set on the most recent regression sweep (ARCHITECTURE.md §6, 95% threshold).

flipped_cases.description: Gold case ids whose score flipped since the previous sweep.
